scope: Independent exact coefficient/proof-obligation audit only, before code/execution. No full sampler, model, dataset, gold, neural head/forward, update or timing campaign.
stages: Freeze README, proof and this protocol before implementing a coefficient reference.
Freeze reference and independent auditor before executing any scientific case. Preserve failures.
Check finite differences, boxes, all exact elevation coefficients and normalized mixture bounds at every listed degree/function.
Keep full-work/priority gap open; small correctness does not trigger a neural or broad sampler campaign.
functions: same C2 spline with reflected argument1-p; retain both stencil directions
requirements: Every k at n and4n: stencil in[0,1], three rational value arguments, derivative-free error bound against independent analytic f'', and coefficient box.
Independently form hypergeometric weights with combinatorial integers; verify their normalization and every old->new l/u coefficient inequality and normalized difference in[0,1].

Polynomial cases independently integrate Bernstein coefficients to exact power-basis functions and check representative rational-p approximation inequalities; piecewise cases retain all knots and adjacent stencil arguments.
Independent geometric mixture weights/tails/expected input-count identity; no Monte Carlo frequency replaces the law proof.
Verify known common denominator for the cubic-spline specialization, preserving exact Fraction arithmetic. Do not claim naive implementation has the fast bit-work theorem.

Include a raw-value coefficient control, an analytic-derivative correction control and ordinary Boolean-sum coefficient control at representative interior points; record exact values and f-call counts, without declaring a timing or general-algorithm win.
Reject invalid degrees, range metadata, negative bounds and out-of-range k. No clipping of an invalid coefficient.
